metrics.revenue: Total revenues / net sales / operating revenues, FY2022 (USD millions)
metrics.net_income: Net income attributable to the company's shareholders, FY2022 (USD millions)
metrics.capex: Capital expenditures (purchases of PP&E), FY2022 cash flow statement (USD millions, positive)
metrics.total_assets: Total assets at FY2022 year end (USD millions)
metrics.operating_cash_flow: Net cash provided by operating activities, FY2022 (USD millions)
metrics.total_current_assets: Total current assets at FY2022 year end (USD millions); NA if unclassified balance sheet
metrics.total_current_liabilities: Total current liabilities at FY2022 year end (USD millions); NA if unclassified
metrics.dividends_paid: Cash dividends paid to common shareholders, FY2022 (USD millions, positive)
